summary: This guide covers team compositions, gear setups, skill timings, and export codes for Week 3 of the Continental Challenge (Imperial Shadow Recast), requiring six separate teams. Detailed breakdowns are provided for Tamar using Poison/Toxin, Khrysos using Dauntless, Vinyara using Necrosis/Shadow, Twitch using Aura, and Vasska using Frost/Necrosis. The video highlights both premium high-investment rosters capable of hundreds of millions in damage and accessible free-to-play alternatives utilizing epic and rare units to easily achieve the 12 million S-rank damage threshold. Specific encounter mechanics, such as positioning Lothair behind Tamar and utilizing Fitz's debuff transfers against Vasska, are explained.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Needs Enlightenment and Attack; jumping behind Tamar at 40 poison stacks prevents attack penalties.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.verdict: Core damage dealer for Poison teams
heroes.note: Built with high Enlightenment, Attack, and Accuracy; stays safely in position and resists stuns due to self-buffs.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Switched to Poison element with Dragonbone Catalyst and Puppeteer set to boost team damage.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Requires over 250 Resistance to survive Tamar's targeted damage while stacking Accuracy and offensive stats.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Carries Misty Conch artifact to apply Defense Penalty and benefits from defensive stats and Resistance.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Built for Crit Rate, Crit Damage, Attack, Attack Speed, and Resistance to avoid Khrysos's attack speed debuffs.

heroes.name: Fathomdown
heroes.note: Can enable versatile F2P teams to deal over 100M damage when built with high Skill Haste, Hourglass, and Resistance.

heroes.name: Deverick
heroes.note: Applies Attack Penalty and dispels Vinyara's defensive buffs to neutralize her 30% damage reduction and 60% Defense Up.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Built with high Enlightenment and Attack to leverage Shadow energy resets for rapid damage bursts.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Scales directly with HP percentage stats across off-pieces and runes along with standard Crit stats.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Provides team-wide shields, healing, and Resistance sharing against Twitch's heavy debuffs.

heroes.name: Fitz
heroes.verdict: Key rare tech hero for Vasska
heroes.note: Transfers attack penalties from the entire team back onto himself with his ultimate, enabling Frost allies to deal full damage.

heroes.name: Voresh
heroes.note: Applies Buff Prohibition via Puppeteer set and Witch's Remains to lower the boss's damage output.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Grants Invisibility and groups enemies together; requires enough Skill Haste to align his ultimate within an 18-second rotation.

teams.note: Full Poison team running an 18-second rotation; capable of 800M–1.8B damage depending on Inspiration levels.
High-end Dauntless composition built with Resistance on an 18-second rotation dealing 200M–500M damage.
Versatile Dauntless variant utilizing Fathomdown with high Skill Haste to easily deal 70M–100M+ damage.
Shadow/Necrosis composition running on default timing, hitting over 200M damage with Deverick handling boss buffs.
HP-scaling Aura team on an 18-second cycle dealing 500M–700M damage with Solmo providing sustain.
Frost/Necrosis team dealing 240M damage using Fitz's debuff redirection and Torrin's grouping on an 18-second cycle.

tips: Against Tamar, manually time Lothair to leap behind the boss right at 40 poison stacks so he permanently avoids Tamar's attack penalties.
For boss encounters with heavy debuffs like Khrysos and Tamar, build key units with 200+ Resistance or utilize the 'Stand United' talent to share Resistance.
Against Vinyara, ensure you bring a buff dispeller like Deverick to strip her 30% damage reduction and 60% defense buffs.
Against Vasska, rare hero Fitz can redirect all attack penalties from allies to himself, allowing rare and epic Frost units to deal massive damage.
Standardize team ultimate cooldowns around an 18-second skill rotation cycle to align with Continental Challenge boss ability windows.
